description: This file defines factory classes and creation functions for OFDM modulator, demodulator, and PRACH demodulator components within the ocudu namespace, including their configurations and external dependencies.

classes.name: ofdm_modulator_factory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating OFDM modulators with symbol and slot granularity.

classes.name: ofdm_demodulator_factory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating OFDM demodulators with symbol and slot granularity.

classes.name: ofdm_prach_demodulator_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating OFDM PRACH demodulators.

methods.name: create_ofdm_symbol_modulator
methods.description: Creates an OFDM symbol modulator based on provided configuration.

methods.name: create_ofdm_slot_modulator
methods.description: Creates an OFDM slot modulator based on provided configuration.

methods.name: create_ofdm_symbol_demodulator
methods.description: Creates an OFDM symbol demodulator based on provided configuration.

methods.name: create_ofdm_slot_demodulator
methods.description: Creates an OFDM slot demodulator based on provided configuration.
